model: Modulex boilers with BCM and ACS / BMS II (ProtoNode RER)
equipment_type: Boiler controller and plant sequencer via ProtoNode gateway
applies_to: AERCO Modulex boilers with a BCM, up to four, plus an ACS or BMS II sequencer, read through the AERCO ProtoNode RER.
summary: The AERCO ProtoNode RER profile for four Modulex boilers with BCM controllers and one ACS or BMS II serves 54 analog values on BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP. Each Modulex has modulation, setpoint, temperature, status and error values plus a writable requested outlet temperature and direct-drive modulation; the ACS/BMS II adds plant header values and a writable network header setpoint.
default_device_instance: Node_Offset + A-bank DIP switch value (MAC); the manual's example uses Node_Offset 50,000
notes: Older document (OMM-0080_0H, November 2014) for the ProtoNode RER gateway.
Object IDs are fixed per profile and do not follow a formula; the ACS/BMS II IDs for Net Blr 1-4 Status differ from the C-More profiles.
Modulex temperatures are held in the BCM Modbus registers as value x 10; the manual does not say whether the gateway scales them.
Error code (11-Error Code): low byte is the error, high byte the device (0-7 = BMM 0-7, 255 = BCM); the manual has BCM and BMM fault tables.

integration.summary: Set S0 and S1 On (S2, S3, A1 Off) for the BACnet profile with 4 Modulex and 1 ACS/BMS II, set each BCM's address DIP switches to 1-4 and the ACS/BMS II to Modbus address 128. Plant setpoint goes to AV 33 on the ACS/BMS II; each Modulex also has a writable requested outlet temperature and a direct-drive modulation value.

minimum_points.name: 03-Net Header Set Temp
minimum_points.why: Plant header setpoint via ACS/BMS II, 40-220 °F

minimum_points.name: 11-Error Code
minimum_points.why: Modulex 1 error code and faulted device

integration.enable: No start/stop object. The ACS/BMS II takes the plant setpoint from AV 33 when Header Set Mode = Remote Setpt and Remote Signal = Network. Each Modulex has writable 03-Req Outlet Temp and 04-Net Direct Drive values; the manual lists the BCM setup as the same as monitor-only.
integration.heartbeat: The BAS must write the setpoint at least three times within the ACS/BMS II Network Timeout (default 30 s, 5-240 s).
setup: S0 On, S1 On, S2-S3 Off, A1 Off = BACnet IP / MS/TP profile with 1 ACS/BMS II and 4 Modulex boilers with BCMs.
Device instance = Node_Offset (set in the Web Configurator) + A-bank DIP value; MS/TP MAC is 1-127 on A0-A7, baud on B0-B3.
Default IP 192.168.1.24; change it in the ProtoNode web GUI.
Modbus side: every AERCO unit at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity.
Modulex BCM address DIP switches 1-4; ACS/BMS II at Modbus address 128 through an RS-232 to RS-485 converter.
gotchas: Modulex point names repeat for each boiler; the boiler number is in the description.
BCM temperatures are value x 10 in the Modbus registers; check scaling on the BACnet side.

source.title: AERCO ProtoNode Gateway User Manual (ProtoNode-RER / ProtoNode-LER), GF-129
